answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by giving every voice a slashable identity bond. An agent must post stake before its attestations count, and each attestation is signed, stake-weighted, and checked against a graph rejecting clusters forged by one operator. A sybil farm must then fund a separate bond per fake identity, keeping them apart across the juniper of shared rails, since reuse links the cluster and forfeits it all. Reaching the lotus of high reputation at the summit thus burns capital once peers spot coordinated voting, so each extra voice costs the attacker real money.
